conventions.rotations: degrees, Euler XYZ, local to the bone, relative to the neutral pose
conventions.positions: offsets from the bone's rest position
conventions.ropes: rope animations assume the ropes are behind the wrestler (+Z), top rope about 1.25 m up, about 0.4 m behind the feet
conventions.rootMotionCurve: library v3: rootMotion.mode "curve", keys [t, x, y, z, yawDeg] in the start frame (x right, y up, -z forward); policy "gameplay" keeps the root bone at the object, see README-library.md
conventions.placement: library v3: placement.frame "rope" (rope line z=0, ring z>0, mat y=0) or "corner" (post at origin, ring x>0 z>0); placement.frameStart [x, y, z, yawDeg] in that frame

rootMotionModes.inPlace: Looping locomotion. The game moves the wrestler at 'speed' m/s along 'direction' (local).
rootMotionModes.speedCurve: One-shot movement. The game moves the wrestler using 'speedCurve' [[time, m/s], ...]. Wrestler.getRootSpeed() samples it.
rootMotionModes.baked: The hips travel inside the clip. When the next clip starts, the loader moves the wrestler by the hips' XZ offset ('endOffset' at the end of the clip). Optional endRotationY (degrees) turns the wrestler when the next clip starts; applied by loader-ext.js.
rootMotionModes.curve: Library v3. Declared travel curve in the start frame; ttw-anim-runtime.js samples it (RootMotion.targetAt) and never accumulates anything undeclared.

poseStates.standing: default; any clip without a starts-* tag starts here
poseStates.lying-back: flat on the back, head towards +Z (behind), feet towards the wrestler's origin
poseStates.kneeling: on both knees, sitting back on the heels
poseStates.rope-lean: leaning back on the ropes (ropes behind, +Z)
poseStates.airborne-back: held horizontal on the back at waist height (receiver of a slam)
poseStates.tags: starts-<state> / ends-<state> on each animation; loader-ext.js exposes getStartState, getEndState, animationsFrom
poseStates.apron: standing on the apron outside the ropes, facing the ring
poseStates.apron-hanging: outside the ropes, holding the top rope, feet on the apron edge
poseStates.rope-tangled: arms caught between the top and middle rope
poseStates.corner-perched: standing on the top turnbuckle, facing the ring
poseStates.corner-seated: sitting on the top turnbuckle, facing the ring
poseStates.corner-slumped: seated against the corner post on the mat
poseStates.floor: standing on the arena floor at ringside

events.hit: A strike reaches its target. Fields: attachment or bone (contact point), zone (head/body/legs), reach (metres in front of the attacker).
events.hit_received: Start of a damage reaction. Fields: zone.
events.grab: Hands close on the opponent. Fields: attachment.
events.release: The opponent or prop is let go, or a clip hands over to the next one. Fields: next (suggested follow-up animation id).
events.rope_contact: Body meets the ropes. Fields: attachment.
events.rebound: The ropes push the wrestler back out.
events.land: Body or feet hit the mat. Fields: zone.
events.recover: From here the wrestler can be given new commands.
events.weapon_impact: A held prop hits something. Fields: attachment, prop.
events.table_break: The table should switch to its broken state.
events.finished: Emitted by the loader when a non-looping clip ends (not stored in the animation files).
events.attack_start: An attack begins (its committed part). Fields: role.
events.grip_locked: A hold is secure: from here the defender follows the attacker.
events.lift_complete: The lift reaches its top position.
events.impact: A body lands hard on a surface (mat, apron, floor, turnbuckle). Fields: surface.
events.rope_release: Hands or body leave the ropes.
events.apex: Top of a jump or flight.
events.stun_start: A dazed state begins (stun loop can follow).
events.animation_complete: Last frame of a one-shot clip (always present on library v3 clips).
